tools.name: calculate_asia_miles
tools.description: Calculate Asia Miles redemption plans for 1-segment direct or 2-segment connecting itineraries. Automatically returns Full Economy, Full Business, and proportional Mixed-Cabin (Business + Economy / Economy + Business) mileage options, savings vs Full Business, route validation, and direct vs via-HKG
